PORT AUTHORITIES ACT 1963

Port AUTHORITIES (Kemaman Port) ORDER 1993

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 47 of the Port
Authorities Act 1963, the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the
following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Port Authorities (Kemaman
Port) Order 1993 and shall come into force on the 1st September

2. The First Schedule to the Port Authorities Act 1963 which is
referred to in this Order as the "Act" is amended by inserting the
words "Kemaman Port", "Kemaman Port Authority" and
"Ist September 1993" in the first, second and third columns,
respectively.             |

3. Except for Part VIII, the provisions of the Act shall apply to
Kemaman Port.

Made the 18th August 1993,
[KP/BM/JL/0.175/3 Jd.; PN. (PU?) 175/3 Pt. IV.]

By Command,

Dato' Seri Dr Linc Lionc SIK,
Minister of Transport
